description:
Naming ideas grounded in about 700 real product names, each with domain, TLD, category, naming
pattern, length, syllables, casing and domain style (getX.com, Xhq.com…), plus stats for the
whole match, e.g. "short invented names for AI tools on .ai". Traits are heuristics; check
trademarks and domains before using a new name.

category.description: Comma-separated categories (OR), e.g. "AI tools", "Developer tools" or "finance".

dnsHint.description: Optional and slower - up to 10 candidate domains, comma-separated (e.g. tallyho.com,tallyho.ai), each checked for DNS records over DNS-over-HTTPS. A hint, not a registrar check.

domainStyle.description: Comma-separated domain styles (OR) - exact, prefixed, suffixed, domain-hack, subdomain, partial, different.

length.description: Letters in the name (spaces and punctuation not counted) - a number or a range like 4-6, -6 or 8-.

pattern.description:
Comma-separated naming patterns (OR) - real-word, compound, blend, altered, suffix, prefix,
acronym, alphanumeric, person-place, brand-extension, invented.

q.description: Words matched against the name, domain, category and the product's own description; any word can match. Ranked by relevance unless sort is given - more matched words first, then a name or category match above a description match, and rarer words above common ones.

sort.description: Order of results - relevance (the default with q), name (the default without q), length or syllables (shortest first).

source.description: library (products Screenrove has captured) or targets (the Mobbin/Refero list).

startsWith.description: Letters the name starts with, or vowel or consonant.

syllables.description: Syllables - a number or a range like 1-2.

name: search_names
title: Search real product names and their naming patterns
